summary: Added a verified CTE composition cookbook and executable Search-to-text-interpretation coverage for strict, tolerant and partial parsing while preserving candidate provenance and labeling literal prefilters as candidate-only.

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only Search composition tests and the owning repository's Search composition cookbook changed, plus this scope's evidence. The public Search schema, evaluator, sibling repositories, package versions and publication state were not changed.
implementation.composition: search.lines candidates are projected through a CTE before one Parse/TryParse/PartialParse APPLY per candidate physical line. Path, Origin, LineNumber and OccurrenceCount remain beside interpreted fields; repeated matches on one line remain one parsed row.
implementation.failureSemantics: Strict Parse is observed as a typed ParseException. OUTER APPLY TryParse preserves the malformed candidate with null parsed fields. PartialParse preserves the candidate and exposes ErrorField, ErrorMessage and BytesConsumed.
implementation.prefilter: The ERROR literal is explicitly candidate-only. A valid INFO fixture without ERROR proves that an empty prefiltered result is not a completeness claim.
implementation.bindingBoundary: The CTE shape is the verified packaged-evaluator form. An unwrapped source-field-plus-parser projection probe hung in this evaluator revision, so it is not advertised and no sibling engine source was edited.

scenarios: Valid parsed candidate retains path, origin, physical line and occurrence count
Strict Parse exposes a malformed record failure
OUTER APPLY TryParse preserves a malformed candidate as null
PartialParse exposes failed field, message and consumed count
A valid record without the literal is labeled candidate-only
